sources.ros-tracking: per-repo locator, see signal.locator: github-tags (?per_page=100) | github-releases (?per_page=100) | contents-dirs (one listing) | raw-json (one file); first page only
sources.ros-lag: per-repo manifest locator, see repo-config.ts rosLagLocator (raw file, or newest release notes for github-releases)
sources.ci-health: GitHub Actions API: /actions/workflows (?per_page=100, first page only) + /actions/workflows/{id}/runs?branch=<defaultBranch>&per_page=1
sources.community: GitHub Issues API: /issues?state=open&per_page=100&sort=created&direction=desc, external-author filter (owners: Amm0Bot, mobileskyfi)
sources.work: GitHub Issues API (same page as community, all authors) + Pulls API /pulls?state=open&per_page=100 for draft flags; no bodies/comments
sources.npm: GitHub contents API for package.json + npm registry packument https://registry.npmjs.org/<pkg> (dist-tags, versions, time)

coverage.note: Only DASHBOARD_REPOS entries (repo-config.ts) are collected. Single 100-item pages: counts from a full page should be treated as lower bounds.
